summary: Apple action accents enabled on upgrade, private find and replace rules, and guarded layout prewarm.

changes.title: Apple key accents enabled
changes.detail: One-time upgrade activates Return and contextual action accents; later manual opt-out is respected. Glass transparency is unchanged.

changes.title: Find & replace rules
changes.detail: Create encrypted reusable literal rules in BR Brain and apply to selected text with case, whole-word and first/all controls.

changes.title: Panel layout prewarm
changes.detail: Bounded idle warming of Emoji and Clipboard layout data only, canceled on touch or editor changes; no background clipboard reads.

changes.title: Accent setting
changes.detail: Description now includes Return and contextual actions.
